facts.finding: The site overview expressly assigns operation to 株式会社ハイレゾ香川 (Highreso Kagawa). The historical announcement expressly calls Highreso Kagawa a subsidiary of 株式会社ハイレゾ (Highreso). Prefer local operator Highreso Kagawa with Highreso group relationship in notes; do not invent building ownership or tenancy from this.

facts.locator: Historical opening paragraph and partial-research-facility conversion paragraph; prefecture section4; fresh release facility overview
facts.finding: December 19, 2024 opening is explicit. Highreso reused part of the Kagawa Industry Support Foundation research facility. The prefecture locates it within the foundation premises at Hayashi-cho, Takamatsu and reports approximately 687 sqm, matching both operator releases. This reconciles the same facility across dates, but does not itself select a particular RIST building coordinate.

facts.locator: Named-facility headings; historical future-site descriptions; prefecture sections 3 and 4; business page facility list
facts.finding: 高松市データセンター is the repeated source name. Highreso Kagawa Takamatsu City Data Center and ハイレゾ香川 高松市データセンター combine that source name with the explicit operator for descriptive normalization; the latter composite string was seen in a government opening-document search excerpt but is not claimed as a literal quotation from these selected captures. GPUSOROBAN is a service brand, not a unique physical-site alias. Genkai in Saga and Ayagawa in Kagawa are separate former-school facilities. The Tokyo headquarters and Genkai registered-office address in the footer are not the Takamatsu DC address.

Approximately687sqm is floor area, not land or full-host-campus area. No IT-load MW value is selected. Do not convert investment or GPU/server counts into MW, or carry the historical 408 HGX H200 quantity into an asserted current installed inventory. The fresh release does not establish full-building occupancy or a new physical expansion.

Government location bridge and independent identity corroboration; February 2026 is outside the new status freshness window and is not selected as latest status.
